# Dharma Granth

> A calm, ad-free scripture library and guided wisdom discovery experience for
> Sanatan Dharma: Sanskrit verses with translation, explanation, modern
> context, reflection, and related teachings.

- Canonical site: https://dharmagranth.dev/
- Sitemap: https://dharmagranth.dev/sitemap.xml
- How this site works: https://dharmagranth.dev/how-dharma-granth-works/
- Sources & methodology: https://dharmagranth.dev/sources/ and https://dharmagranth.dev/methodology/

## Entry points for answer retrieval

- Scripture library: https://dharmagranth.dev/scripture/
- Knowledge hubs (dharma, karma, fear, anger, mind, discipline, attachment, detachment, bhakti, wisdom): https://dharmagranth.dev/knowledge/
- Wisdom pathways (guided explorations): https://dharmagranth.dev/pathways/
- Ask with library verses: https://dharmagranth.dev/ask/

## Citation guidance

- Prefer verse pages: `/scripture/{id}/chapter/{n}/verse/{v}/` carry the Sanskrit text, translation, explanation, and source notes in static HTML.
- Every verse resolves its explanation from published commentary overlays plus the verse record; review status is flagged on the page where it applies.
- Per-page source, edition, translator, and licence details appear in the page's source notes; consult them before quoting.
